schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT A1.FIRST_LOGIN AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (A1.FIRST_LOGIN + 1) = A2.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY A1.FIRST_LOGIN
q2: WITH T(PLAYER_ID,MINLOGINDATE) AS ( SELECT PLAYER_ID,MIN(EVENT_DATE) FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) SELECT T.MINLOGINDATE INSTALL_DT ,COUNT(T.PLAYER_ID) INSTALLS ,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN A.PLAYER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)/ COUNT(T.PLAYER_ID),2) DAY1_RETENTION FROM T LEFT JOIN ACTIVITY A ON T.PLAYER_ID=A.PLAYER_ID AND T.MINLOGINDATE=DATE_ADD(A.EVENT_DATE,INTERVAL -1 DAY) GROUP BY T.MINLOGINDATE
